name: Uttar Pradesh Expressways Industrial Development Authority
summary: The Uttar Pradesh government body behind the state's long expressways — Agra–Lucknow, Purvanchal, Bundelkhand and Ganga.
about: UPEIDA was set up by the Uttar Pradesh government to build expressways across the state and develop the land beside them. Rather than one long road, it has built a series of them fanning out from Lucknow, each opening up a part of the state that trains and older highways served slowly. Its expressways are known for being built quickly and for having emergency airstrips on them, where air force fighter jets have landed during exercises.
facts: Built the Agra–Lucknow, Purvanchal, Bundelkhand and Gorakhpur Link Expressways.
Several of its expressways have airstrips on them for air force emergency landings.
The Ganga Expressway, its longest project, runs from Meerut to Prayagraj.
